package contract_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	contract "__CONTRACT_IMPORT__"
	protogen "__PROTOGEN_IMPORT__"

	"github.com/moby/extensions/stream"
	"google.golang.org/grpc"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/credentials/insecure"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/wrapperspb"
	"gotest.tools/v3/assert"
)

type provider struct {
	downloadValues []int32
	downloadNil    bool
	downloadErr    error
	downloadWait   <-chan struct{}
	downloadStart  chan struct{}
	downloadDone   chan struct{}

	downloadStartOnce sync.Once
	downloadDoneOnce  sync.Once

	uploadErr         error
	uploadRejectAfter int
	uploadWait        <-chan struct{}
	uploadStart       chan struct{}
	uploadDone        chan struct{}
	uploadObservedErr error
	uploadDoneOnce    sync.Once
	uploadStartOnce   sync.Once
	uploadValues      []int32
	uploadFinalized   atomic.Bool
	unaryErr          error
	legacyErr         error
}

var _ contract.Service = (*provider)(nil)

func (p *provider) Unary(_ context.Context, req *contract.Request) (*contract.Reply, error) {
	if p.unaryErr != nil {
		return nil, p.unaryErr
	}
	return &contract.Reply{Values: []int32{req.Value}}, nil
}

func (p *provider) Remove(context.Context, *contract.Request) error {
	return p.legacyErr
}

func (p *provider) Download(ctx context.Context, _ *contract.Request, sender stream.Sender[contract.Chunk]) error {
	return p.download(ctx, sender)
}

func (p *provider) DownloadAgain(ctx context.Context, _ *contract.Request, sender stream.Sender[contract.Chunk]) error {
	return p.download(ctx, sender)
}

func (p *provider) download(ctx context.Context, sender stream.Sender[contract.Chunk]) error {
	p.signalDownloadStart()
	defer p.signalDownloadDone()
	if p.downloadNil {
		return sender.Send(nil)
	}
	for _, value := range p.downloadValues {
		message := &contract.Chunk{Value: value}
		if err := sender.Send(message); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if p.downloadWait != nil {
		select {
		case <-p.downloadWait:
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return ctx.Err()
		}
	}
	return p.downloadErr
}

func (p *provider) Upload(ctx context.Context, receiver stream.Receiver[contract.Chunk]) (*contract.Reply, error) {
	values, err := p.receive(ctx, receiver)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &contract.Reply{Values: values}, nil
}

func (p *provider) UploadAgain(ctx context.Context, receiver stream.Receiver[contract.Chunk]) (*contract.AlternateReply, error) {
	values, err := p.receive(ctx, receiver)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &contract.AlternateReply{Values: values, Marker: "alternate"}, nil
}

func (p *provider) receive(ctx context.Context, receiver stream.Receiver[contract.Chunk]) ([]int32, error) {
	p.signalUploadStart()
	defer p.signalUploadDone()
	for {
		message, err := receiver.Recv()
		if err != nil {
			if !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
				p.uploadObservedErr = err
				return nil, err
			}
			p.uploadFinalized.Store(true)
			return append([]int32(nil), p.uploadValues...), nil
		}
		if message == nil {
			err := errors.New("provider received nil message")
			p.uploadObservedErr = err
			return nil, err
		}
		p.uploadValues = append(p.uploadValues, message.Value)
		if p.uploadRejectAfter > 0 && len(p.uploadValues) >= p.uploadRejectAfter {
			return nil, p.uploadErr
		}
		if p.uploadWait != nil {
			select {
			case <-p.uploadWait:
			case <-ctx.Done():
				p.uploadObservedErr = ctx.Err()
				return nil, ctx.Err()
			}
		}
	}
}

func (p *provider) signalDownloadStart() {
	if p.downloadStart != nil {
		p.downloadStartOnce.Do(func() { close(p.downloadStart) })
	}
}

func (p *provider) signalDownloadDone() {
	if p.downloadDone != nil {
		p.downloadDoneOnce.Do(func() { close(p.downloadDone) })
	}
}

func (p *provider) signalUploadStart() {
	if p.uploadStart != nil {
		p.uploadStartOnce.Do(func() { close(p.uploadStart) })
	}
}

func (p *provider) signalUploadDone() {
	if p.uploadDone != nil {
		p.uploadDoneOnce.Do(func() { close(p.uploadDone) })
	}
}

type runtimeMode struct {
	name string
	new  func(*testing.T, *provider) contract.Service
}

func runtimeModes() []runtimeMode {
	return []runtimeMode{
		{
			name: "direct",
			new: func(_ *testing.T, p *provider) contract.Service {
				return p
			},
		},
		{
			name: "remote",
			new: func(t *testing.T, p *provider) contract.Service {
				return start(t, p)
			},
		},
	}
}

func start(t *testing.T, p *provider) contract.Service {
	t.Helper()
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	assert.NilError(t, err)
	server := grpc.NewServer()
	protogen.ServerPoint.Register(server, p)
	serveDone := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { serveDone <- server.Serve(listener) }()

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	conn, err := grpc.DialContext(
		ctx,
		listener.Addr().String(),
		grpc.WithTransportCredentials(insecure.NewCredentials()),
		grpc.WithBlock(),
	)
	cancel()
	if err != nil {
		server.Stop()
		<-serveDone
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		_ = conn.Close()
		server.Stop()
		<-serveDone
	})
	return protogen.NewClient(conn)
}

func await(t *testing.T, signal <-chan struct{}) {
	t.Helper()
	timer := time.NewTimer(10 * time.Second)
	defer timer.Stop()
	select {
	case <-signal:
	case <-timer.C:
		t.Fatal("timed out waiting for handler cleanup")
	}
}

type release struct {
	ch   chan struct{}
	once sync.Once
}

func newRelease() *release {
	return &release{ch: make(chan struct{})}
}

func (r *release) Close() {
	r.once.Do(func() { close(r.ch) })
}

func asyncErrorCall(t *testing.T, call func() error) <-chan error {
	t.Helper()
	result := make(chan error, 1)
	done := make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		result <- call()
		close(done)
	}()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		timer := time.NewTimer(10 * time.Second)
		defer timer.Stop()
		select {
		case <-done:
		case <-timer.C:
			t.Errorf("timed out waiting for asynchronous call")
		}
	})
	return result
}

type uploadResult struct {
	reply *contract.Reply
	err   error
}

func asyncUploadCall(t *testing.T, call func() (*contract.Reply, error)) <-chan uploadResult {
	t.Helper()
	result := make(chan uploadResult, 1)
	done := make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		reply, err := call()
		result <- uploadResult{reply: reply, err: err}
		close(done)
	}()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		timer := time.NewTimer(10 * time.Second)
		defer timer.Stop()
		select {
		case <-done:
		case <-timer.C:
			t.Errorf("timed out waiting for asynchronous upload")
		}
	})
	return result
}

type source struct {
	ready  <-chan struct{}
	values []*contract.Chunk
	last   error
	index  int
}

func (s *source) Recv() (*contract.Chunk, error) {
	if s.ready != nil {
		ready := s.ready
		s.ready = nil
		<-ready
	}
	if s.index < len(s.values) {
		message := s.values[s.index]
		s.index++
		return message, nil
	}
	return nil, s.last
}

type contextSource struct {
	ctx     context.Context
	values  []*contract.Chunk
	index   int
	started chan struct{}
	once    sync.Once
}

func (s *contextSource) Recv() (*contract.Chunk, error) {
	if s.index < len(s.values) {
		message := s.values[s.index]
		s.index++
		return message, nil
	}
	s.once.Do(func() { close(s.started) })
	<-s.ctx.Done()
	return nil, s.ctx.Err()
}

type sink struct {
	values []int32
	err    error
	mu     sync.Mutex
}

func (s *sink) Send(message *contract.Chunk) error {
	if s.err != nil {
		return s.err
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.values = append(s.values, message.Value)
	s.mu.Unlock()
	return nil
}

func detailError(code codes.Code, message, reason string) error {
	st, err := status.New(code, message).WithDetails(wrapperspb.String(reason))
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return st.Err()
}

func assertDetail(t *testing.T, err error, code codes.Code, message, reason string) {
	t.Helper()
	st, ok := status.FromError(err)
	assert.Assert(t, ok)
	assert.Equal(t, st.Code(), code)
	assert.Equal(t, st.Message(), message)
	details := st.Details()
	assert.Equal(t, len(details), 1)
	info, ok := details[0].(*wrapperspb.StringValue)
	assert.Assert(t, ok)
	assert.Equal(t, info.Value, reason)
}

func TestUnaryAndBareError(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	p := &provider{}
	client := start(t, p)
	reply, err := client.Unary(context.Background(), &contract.Request{Value: 7})
	assert.NilError(t, err)
	assert.DeepEqual(t, reply.Values, []int32{7})
	assert.NilError(t, client.Remove(context.Background(), &contract.Request{}))

	p.unaryErr = errors.Join(errors.New("wrapped cancellation"), context.Canceled)
	_, err = client.Unary(context.Background(), &contract.Request{})
	assert.Equal(t, status.Code(err), codes.Canceled)
}

func TestDirectAndRemoteParity(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range runtimeModes() {
		t.Run(mode.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			t.Parallel()
			t.Run("empty and multiple downloads", func(t *testing.T) {
				p := &provider{}
				client := mode.new(t, p)
				got := &sink{}
				assert.NilError(t, client.Download(context.Background(), &contract.Request{}, got))
				assert.Equal(t, len(got.values), 0)

				p = &provider{downloadValues: []int32{1, 2, 3}}
				client = mode.new(t, p)
				got = &sink{}
				assert.NilError(t, client.Download(context.Background(), &contract.Request{}, got))
				assert.DeepEqual(t, got.values, []int32{1, 2, 3})

				p = &provider{downloadValues: []int32{4, 5}}
				client = mode.new(t, p)
				got = &sink{}
				assert.NilError(t, client.DownloadAgain(context.Background(), &contract.Request{}, got))
				assert.DeepEqual(t, got.values, []int32{4, 5})
			})

			t.Run("empty and multiple uploads", func(t *testing.T) {
				p := &provider{}
				client := mode.new(t, p)
				reply, err := client.Upload(context.Background(), &source{last: io.EOF})
				assert.NilError(t, err)
				assert.Equal(t, len(reply.Values), 0)

				p = &provider{}
				client = mode.new(t, p)
				reply, err = client.Upload(context.Background(), &source{
					values: []*contract.Chunk{{Value: 2}, {Value: 4}, {Value: 6}},
					last:   errors.Join(errors.New("input complete"), io.EOF),
				})
				assert.NilError(t, err)
				assert.DeepEqual(t, reply.Values, []int32{2, 4, 6})
				assert.Assert(t, p.uploadFinalized.Load())

				p = &provider{}
				client = mode.new(t, p)
				alternate, err := client.UploadAgain(context.Background(), &source{
					values: []*contract.Chunk{{Value: 8}},
					last:   io.EOF,
				})
				assert.NilError(t, err)
				assert.DeepEqual(t, alternate.Values, []int32{8})
				assert.Equal(t, alternate.Marker, "alternate")
			})

			t.Run("final status follows delivered download data", func(t *testing.T) {
				p := &provider{
					downloadValues: []int32{10, 20},
					downloadErr:    detailError(codes.FailedPrecondition, "final rejection", "FINAL_REJECTION"),
				}
				client := mode.new(t, p)
				got := &sink{}
				err := client.Download(context.Background(), &contract.Request{}, got)
				assert.DeepEqual(t, got.values, []int32{10, 20})
				assertDetail(t, err, codes.FailedPrecondition, "final rejection", "FINAL_REJECTION")
			})
		})
	}
}

func TestServerStreamingInvalidProviderMessage(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	p := &provider{downloadNil: true}
	client := start(t, p)
	err := client.Download(context.Background(), &contract.Request{}, &sink{})
	assert.Equal(t, status.Code(err), codes.Internal)
}

func TestDirectAndRemoteErrorIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range runtimeModes() {
		t.Run(mode.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			t.Parallel()
			t.Run("destination error is local and exact", func(t *testing.T) {
				p := &provider{
					downloadValues: []int32{1},
					downloadStart:  make(chan struct{}),
					downloadDone:   make(chan struct{}),
				}
				client := mode.new(t, p)
				destinationErr := errors.New("destination failed")
				result := asyncErrorCall(t, func() error {
					return client.Download(context.Background(), &contract.Request{}, &sink{err: destinationErr})
				})
				var started bool
				select {
				case <-p.downloadStart:
					started = true
				case err := <-result:
					assert.Equal(t, err, destinationErr)
				}
				if started {
					assert.Equal(t, <-result, destinationErr)
					await(t, p.downloadDone)
				}
			})

			t.Run("source error is local and not a clean EOF", func(t *testing.T) {
				sourceErr := errors.New("source failed")
				p := &provider{
					uploadStart: make(chan struct{}),
					uploadDone:  make(chan struct{}),
				}
				client := mode.new(t, p)
				source := &source{
					ready:  p.uploadStart,
					values: []*contract.Chunk{{Value: 3}},
					last:   sourceErr,
				}
				result := asyncUploadCall(t, func() (*contract.Reply, error) {
					return client.Upload(context.Background(), source)
				})
				t.Cleanup(p.signalUploadStart)
				await(t, p.uploadStart)
				assert.Equal(t, (<-result).err, sourceErr)
				await(t, p.uploadDone)
				assert.Assert(t, !p.uploadFinalized.Load())
				if mode.name == "direct" {
					assert.Equal(t, p.uploadObservedErr, sourceErr)
				} else {
					assert.Assert(t, p.uploadObservedErr != sourceErr)
				}
			})
		})
	}
}

func TestServerStreamingCallbacksAndCancellation(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	t.Run("canceled transport cleans up handler", func(t *testing.T) {
		release := newRelease()
		p := &provider{
			downloadWait:  release.ch,
			downloadStart: make(chan struct{}),
			downloadDone:  make(chan struct{}),
		}
		client := start(t, p)
		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		result := asyncErrorCall(t, func() error {
			return client.Download(ctx, &contract.Request{}, &sink{})
		})
		t.Cleanup(cancel)
		t.Cleanup(release.Close)
		await(t, p.downloadStart)
		cancel()
		assert.Equal(t, status.Code(<-result), codes.Canceled)
		await(t, p.downloadDone)
	})

	t.Run("deadline does not require an unstarted handler", func(t *testing.T) {
		release := newRelease()
		p := &provider{
			downloadWait:  release.ch,
			downloadStart: make(chan struct{}),
			downloadDone:  make(chan struct{}),
		}
		client := start(t, p)
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Millisecond)
		result := asyncErrorCall(t, func() error {
			return client.Download(ctx, &contract.Request{}, &sink{})
		})
		t.Cleanup(cancel)
		t.Cleanup(release.Close)

		var started bool
		select {
		case <-p.downloadStart:
			started = true
		case err := <-result:
			assert.Equal(t, status.Code(err), codes.DeadlineExceeded)
		}
		if started {
			assert.Equal(t, status.Code(<-result), codes.DeadlineExceeded)
			await(t, p.downloadDone)
		}
	})
}

func TestClientStreamingInvalidInputAndProviderStatus(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	t.Run("nil source message is invalid", func(t *testing.T) {
		p := &provider{
			uploadStart: make(chan struct{}),
			uploadDone:  make(chan struct{}),
		}
		client := start(t, p)
		source := &source{
			ready:  p.uploadStart,
			values: []*contract.Chunk{nil},
			last:   io.EOF,
		}
		result := asyncUploadCall(t, func() (*contract.Reply, error) {
			return client.Upload(context.Background(), source)
		})
		t.Cleanup(p.signalUploadStart)
		await(t, p.uploadStart)
		assert.Equal(t, status.Code((<-result).err), codes.InvalidArgument)
		await(t, p.uploadDone)
		assert.Assert(t, !p.uploadFinalized.Load())
	})

	t.Run("provider final status survives early rejection", func(t *testing.T) {
		p := &provider{
			uploadErr:         detailError(codes.ResourceExhausted, "quota", "UPLOAD_QUOTA"),
			uploadRejectAfter: 1,
			uploadDone:        make(chan struct{}),
		}
		client := start(t, p)
		_, err := client.Upload(context.Background(), &source{
			values: []*contract.Chunk{{Value: 1}, {Value: 2}, {Value: 3}},
			last:   io.EOF,
		})
		assertDetail(t, err, codes.ResourceExhausted, "quota", "UPLOAD_QUOTA")
		await(t, p.uploadDone)
		assert.Assert(t, !p.uploadFinalized.Load())
	})
}

func TestDirectContextCancellation(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	release := newRelease()
	p := &provider{
		downloadWait:  release.ch,
		downloadStart: make(chan struct{}),
		downloadDone:  make(chan struct{}),
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	result := asyncErrorCall(t, func() error {
		return p.Download(ctx, &contract.Request{}, &sink{})
	})
	t.Cleanup(cancel)
	t.Cleanup(release.Close)
	await(t, p.downloadStart)
	cancel()
	assert.Equal(t, <-result, context.Canceled)
	await(t, p.downloadDone)
}

func TestClientStreamingCancellationCleansUpHandler(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	release := newRelease()
	p := &provider{
		uploadStart: make(chan struct{}),
		uploadDone:  make(chan struct{}),
		uploadWait:  release.ch,
	}
	client := start(t, p)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	source := &contextSource{
		ctx:     ctx,
		values:  []*contract.Chunk{{Value: 9}},
		started: make(chan struct{}),
	}
	result := asyncUploadCall(t, func() (*contract.Reply, error) {
		return client.Upload(ctx, source)
	})
	t.Cleanup(cancel)
	t.Cleanup(release.Close)
	t.Cleanup(p.signalUploadStart)
	await(t, p.uploadStart)
	await(t, source.started)
	cancel()
	assert.Equal(t, (<-result).err, context.Canceled)
	await(t, p.uploadDone)
}
